profiles.name: Devin P. Montgomery
profiles.description: Devin P. Montgomery was arrested on September 4, 2025 during ongoing anti-ICE protest activity outside the ICE office in South Portland, Oregon. Federal prosecutors alleged that he continued flying a drone in a temporary restricted area after officers told him to stop and that he spit in an officer’s face during the arrest. He remained in federal custody until September 8, when a magistrate judge released him on conditions.
profiles.finding: No identity-linked portrait located for Portland drone arrest.

profiles.name: John Paul Cupp
profiles.description: John Paul Cupp was arrested in November 2025 after participating in protests outside the ICE office in South Portland, Oregon and posting related political content online. Federal prosecutors alleged that he threatened to kill federal officers and harm their families in remarks at the protest and in later videos. A magistrate judge ordered him detained on November 24, 2025, and the federal case remained pending in September 2026.

profiles.name: Heather Morrow
profiles.description: Heather Morrow was arrested on the morning of November 16, 2025 while protesting immigration enforcement outside the ICE/ERO office in Charlotte, North Carolina. Prosecutors initially alleged that she assaulted a federal officer, but a bystander video contradicted that account and the felony charge was dropped. After a full day and night in custody, she was released on bond on November 17. A federal jury later convicted Morrow of misdemeanor obstruction, failure-to-comply, and simple-assault counts in September 2026; sentencing remained pending.
profiles.finding: Charlotte reporting leads; therapist, photographer, actress and Florida mugshot not matched; Observer image is mother Barbara, not Heather.
